# AlphaPro Fitness

> AlphaPro Fitness is a neighbourhood gym in D Group Employees Layout, Andrahalli, Bengaluru, with a 4,500 sq.ft training floor, certified coaches, air conditioning, free on-site parking, strength training, personal training, CrossFit, bodybuilding, cardio, aerobics and nutrition guidance.

## Contact and location

- Address: D Group Employees Layout, Andrahalli, Bengaluru 560091, Karnataka, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 90710 93361
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/icdGSQxqr8VHFAx37
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/alphaprofitness_1/

## Pages

- [Home](https://alphaprofitness.in/): Gym overview, facilities, programmes, membership summary and contact details.
- [About](https://alphaprofitness.in/about): The people and coaches behind AlphaPro Fitness.
- [Membership](https://alphaprofitness.in/membership): Plans, price comparison, gallery and frequently asked questions.

## Membership plans

- Monthly: ₹2,500 per month.
- Quarterly: ₹5,000 per 3 months.
- Half-yearly: ₹8,000 per 6 months.
- Annual: ₹12,000 per year, including 2 personal training sessions and a 30-day freeze.

## Facilities

- 4,500 sq.ft training floor
- Certified coaches and professional trainers
- Top-brand strength and cardio equipment
- Fully air-conditioned floor
- Dedicated free parking on the premises
- Free 60-minute trial workout for first-time visitors

## Programmes

Strength training, personal training, CrossFit, bodybuilding, weight management, nutrition guidance, cardio and aerobics.
